name: hero_power_spare_mana
description: boss-ai A12 / F9 hero_power: default profile (rules.hero_power = spare_mana), band 2. The boss's hero power deals 1 to the enemy hero (cost = match-rules hero_power_cost, 2); its hand holds one 3-cost vanilla 3/3. At 3 mana the card is playable and must be played; the test lowers the boss to expect.short_mana (2), where no card is playable and the hero power must be used. No card here has a discover or choose_one op.
